profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer Technical Lead
profile.summary:
I’m a Software Engineer with the experience of building scalable, secure, and high-performance web applications. I specialize in Python (Django, Flask, Bottle) and JavaScript frameworks (React, Redux, Angular), with strong expertise in designing REST APIs, backend systems, and cloud-native deployments.



Over the years, I’ve worked across diverse environments—from enterprise platforms at AT&T to network observability solutions at cPacket Networks—where I’ve delivered impactful features like PCAP workflow optimizations, FIPS-compliant security enhancements, Grafana dashboards, and multi-cloud deployments on AWS, Azure, and GCP.



Core Strengths:

- Technologies: Python, JavaScript (React, Redux, Angular), Java (Spring, Hibernate)

- Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, SQLite

- Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Azure, GCP, Terraform, Docker, Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines

- Testing & Quality: TDD/BDD, Unit Testing, Selenium, PyTest

- System design & performance optimization (multithreading, Celery, async processing)

- Agile/Scrum collaboration with cross-functional teams



I’m passionate about solving complex problems, designing scalable platforms, and delivering software that makes a measurable impact. Always curious, I enjoy learning new technologies and applying them to real-world challenges.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Software Engineer at cPacket Networks, I am part of a dynamic team that revolutionizes network performance monitoring and analytics. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses to achieve unparalleled network visibility and efficiency, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.

• Development of cClear features using languages like Python (Bottle), TypeScript, Shell script, Docker and modern web technologies and frameworks like (Angular, REST APIs) etc. to deliver scalable, enterprise-grade observability solutions.
• Enhanced cClear Control Center functionality by enabling centralized provisioning and monitoring of cVu packet brokers and cStor capture appliances, supporting hybrid-cloud and on-premises deployments.
• Optimized PCAP download and packet capture workflows, enabling customers to retrieve large datasets under high-traffic conditions with 100% reliability, even on low-bandwidth networks.
• Designed and integrated Grafana dashboards and plugins, creating customizable visualizations of critical KPIs - key performance indicators (latency, throughput, microbursts) that improved troubleshooting speed and operational insights.
• Implemented FIPS-compliant OpenSSL encryption, strengthening data security and achieving compliance with U.S. federal cybersecurity standards.
• Engineered Eager Build pipelines to proactively patch security vulnerabilities, reducing security risk exposure and accelerating remediation timelines by ~70%.
• Improved scalability and performance of core services by leveraging Python multithreading, Celery distributed task queues, and async processing.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
• Worked on the project involving the creation of the Microservices REST APIs for the Express Ordering tool which creates and manages order for simple and complex products supporting retail business customers across AT&T for Legacy S&B products.
• Worked on ODIN to support Global Ordering Sales and Support (GOSS) community. Used Python, Django, and ReactJS to build an application.
• Worked on Customer Service Provisioning Center (CSPC) Project Tool consisting series of microservices, database, and APIs to automate the project upload.
• Worked extensively with Python and Flask in order to create microservices REST APIs.
• Involved in various phases of the project like Analysis, Design, Development, and Testing.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Built the web applications for the small and large-scale companies that can be used by manufacturers, distributors and resellers for managing, distributing, and publishing their product line content, across any number of digital platforms, from one place.
• Worked on various projects writing Python, Java, AngularJS, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JQuery, etc based on provided designs to get websites and web applications built within a team atmosphere.
• Involved in design and development of web interface using Java, JSP, Servlets.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•  Exposed web design, converted the design into web pages and created e-learning modules using interactive media.
•  Developed a web application which provides online educational services.
•  Designed and analyzed web pages from requirements and data provided using Java, J2EE, JSP, Servlets, MYSQL.

projects.title: 3D Game Development (Rescue Ralphie)
projects.description:
•  Designed and created a single player game in Python using a Panda3D game engine.
•  Applied concepts and techniques from computing and mathematics for game math, collision detection, physics, and graphics.

projects.title: Android Application Development (Nearby Friends, Movie Reviewer, Gratuity)
projects.description:
• Built an app Nearby Friends which helps users discover which friends are nearby or on the go and provided the navigation facility.
• Built an app MovieReviewer to discover popular movie reviews. 
• Built an app Gratuity which helps users to calculate the tip.
